Character A says: तुला किती भाऊ आहेत? [How many brothers do you have?]
Character B says: I am having two brothers.
Character A says: Having नाही. आता हातात धरून ठेवले आहेत का दोघांना? [Not 'having'. Are you holding both of them in your hands right now?]
Character B says: नाही नाही, हातात तर नाही. [No no, not in my hands.]
Character A says: असं बोल. I have two brothers. [Say it like this. I have two brothers.]
Character B says: Ohh... ठीक आहे ठीक आहे. मला English नीट येत नाही. [Ohh... okay okay. I don't know English properly.]
Character A says: काही problem नाही. AI teachers try केलं का? [No problem. Have you tried AI teachers?]
Character B says: ते महाग असतील ना. [They must be expensive, right?]
Character A says: अजिबात नाही. Normal English classes पेक्षा सात पट स्वस्त आहे. [Not at all. It's seven times cheaper than normal English classes.]
